description: M2: Orphaned test directory reported when --include-orphaned is passed

state.note: The test directory 'tests/features/removed_feature' exists on disk but there is no corresponding 'docs/features/removed_feature.feature'. The --include-orphaned flag must be passed for it to appear in output.

stimulus.contract: Status Reporting: post-processing scans tests_dir for directories without matching .feature files. OrphanedDir entities added to StatusReport.orphaned_directories when --include-orphaned. Never affects feature stage or exit code.
stimulus.question: Does the status command detect orphaned directories and include them in the StatusReport when --include-orphaned is set, without affecting exit code?
